parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: Database
parameters.description: The name of the database. The default value is all databases. You can also enter a database name to query. Only one database name can be entered at a time.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time, and the interval between the start time and end time must be 7 days or less. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). > If DAS Enterprise Edition V3 is activated and you use the SQL Explorer and Audit feature it provides, you can query data within the hot data storage duration. You can call [DescribeSqlLogConfig](~~2778837~~) to query the activated Enterprise Edition information.

parameters.name: Form
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to generate an audit file or return a list of SQL records. Valid values:
* **File**: If this value is specified, an audit file is generated and only common parameters are returned. Call the DescribeSQLLogFiles operation to obtain the final download URL of the file.
* **Stream**: default value. A list of SQL records is returned.

> When the value is **File**, only MySQL (with Premium Local SSDs) and SQL Server instances are supported, and a maximum of 1 million log entries are recorded.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Valid values: any value greater than 0 and not exceeding the maximum value of Integer.

Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **30** to **100**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: QueryKeywords
parameters.description:
The keywords used for the query.

- When an audit file is generated through the API (the **Form** request parameter is set to **File**), keyword-based filtering is not supported.

- Separate multiple keywords with spaces. You can specify up to 10 keywords. The logical relationship between keywords is **and**.

- If a field name in the SQL statement uses backticks (\`), you must also include the backticks when using the field name as a keyword. For example, if the field name is \`id\`, enter \`id\` instead of id.

> After you enter keywords, the system matches keywords against **Database**, **User**, and **QueryKeywords** simultaneously. The logical relationship between these three request parameters is **and**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. You can query data within the last 7 days from the current date. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). > If DAS Enterprise Edition V3 is activated and you use the SQL Explorer and Audit feature it provides, you can query data within the hot data storage duration. You can call [DescribeSqlLogConfig](~~2778837~~) to query the activated Enterprise Edition information.

parameters.name: User
parameters.description: The username. The default value is all users. You can also enter a username to query. Only one username can be entered at a time.
